Class VarZinhoTheme

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.ui.VarZinhoTheme
public final class VarZinhoTheme extends Object
VarZinho's complete visual vocabulary and light/dark theme switch.

Every colour, font size and button look the window uses is named here; panels ask for a role (styleTitle(JComponent), styleButton(AbstractButton, ButtonRole)) instead of building their own, so all screens read as one product.
